title: RIP Eric Binnion
summary: A memorial post announcing the passing of Eric Binnion, a member of the WordPress/open source community. Eric was known for his contributions to the WordPress ecosystem, particularly through his work at Mailpoet and various WordPress plugins.
problem_solved: This is a memorial post, not a technical solution article.
why_valuable: Honors the memory and contributions of a community member, providing closure and recognition for his work in the WordPress ecosystem.
